adoption_note: 12.0.0 is a breaking forward-only receipt recovery release: ordinary definitive ERROR receipts persist the complete result and digest, checkpoint and session resume derive Message directly from that result, and OperationError remains a normalized diagnostic projection. Only synthetic terminal tool_cancelled closures remain resultless and lack a definitive digest; model-visible tool_outcome_unknown receipts retain the complete result, digest, and resume_observation evidence. Python and Rust adoption is pending.
